summary: Arm 1 (pbr2b2_vv1, 09:05 UTC, RTX 5080): the line_a curriculum with VELOCITY-ALIGNED spawn views crossed the wall bounce in ~15 min (190M steps) - the backward-frame curriculum of round 1 sat there for 1.5B+ steps - and stands at states ~1100-1120 (the ridge/launch) at 09:20. Greedy evals still at the pit (3.12-3.22) until the curriculum reaches the line's start. Why: line_a flies its launch/flight with the view 139-176 deg backward, where the policy's view warp is ~200x coarser; tools/line_track.py re-flies 960->1300 in the policy frame at 25 Hz. New: --demo-view-velocity, --demo-cooldown, --yaw-sigma-min, explore_phase1 --view-velocity, tools/line_actions.py, tools/line_track.py.
